decisions.notes: The twelve-view renders show a clean, generic jet silhouette but very simplified windows, cockpit and exterior surfaces; this does not meet the requested high-realism detail. No interior was verified.
limitations: No animation actions or authored clips detected; no functional mechanics verified.

decisions.notes: The twelve-view renders show a recognizable tug but a blocky wheelhouse, simple windows and sparse deck detail. It falls short of the requested high-realism finish. No interior was verified.
limitations: Validator reports ten warnings; no animation actions or authored clips detected.

decisions.notes: The twelve-view renders show a recognizable motorcycle and exposed frame, but the engine and body are simplified and the finish is visibly synthetic rather than ultra-realistic. Eight zero-area triangles were reported.
limitations: No animation actions or authored clips detected; wheels and steering were not functionally verified.
